title: Maximum alert for torrential rains in Fukui: three cities under emergency and 340,000 people evacuated
summary: The Japan Meteorological Agency issued a special level 5 alert for Fukui, Ōno, and Katsuyama, where record precipitation caused floods and landslides.

title: Landslides in Nepal leave more than 650 dead and 3,000 missing after glacier rupture
summary: Authorities attribute the catastrophe to the rupture of a glacier that formed a dammed lake, while China and Nepal coordinate rescue efforts.

title: Major Leagues: Ohtani postpones return as pitcher due to elbow and knee discomfort
summary: The Dodgers rule out the Japanese star returning to the rotation this season after recording three hits as designated hitter in his last game.

title: Ishin Party fields 20 candidates in Fukuoka prefectural elections after local leader's departure
summary: Yoshimura's party seeks to expand beyond Kansai as non-liberal forces such as Sanseitō and the Democratic Party for the People also increase their candidacies.

title: Three bodies found in a home in Murakami, Niigata, with no signs of intrusion
summary: Police investigate the deaths of an 80-year-old couple and their 63-year-old son, whose bodies were discovered by relatives.
